claims.paraphrase: Page title.
Tidy is an optional copy-edit pass an editor runs over their own draft.
The style conventions Tidy enforces are configurable.
Tidy is opt-in, off by default, and never runs on its own; an editor triggers it from inside a draft.
An editor reviews each proposed change as a diff and accepts or rejects hunks before anything is saved.
Section heading.
The Anthropic SDK is an optional peer dependency that npm does not install automatically.
A site that never turns Tidy on builds cleanly without the SDK.
Install command for the SDK.
Set tidy.enabled in site.config.yaml and bind ANTHROPIC_API_KEY as a Worker secret.
YAML snippet enabling tidy.
Wrangler command that stores the API key secret.
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is the one optional platform binding.
No command checks the API key.
The settings screen probes the key and tells a missing key from a rejected one.
A rejected key fails a tidy run with a reason, logs tidy.failed auth, and closes the feature.
Section heading.
YAML snippet setting tidy.model to the Haiku model.
The default model is claude-sonnet-5.
Sonnet 5 is called the judgment floor for a light copy-edit.
Tidy runs at the low effort tier by default.
Haiku is a documented cheaper and faster model choice.
The model is a developer-tier setting shown read-only to editors; changing it means editing tidy.model.
tidy.conventions adds style rules beyond the always-on objective fixes.
YAML snippet declaring four conventions.
Only fixes defaults on; enabled alone runs the objective fixes only.
Table header row.
The fixes toggle is claimed to switch off the objective fixes.
fixes is a boolean defaulting to true.
oxfordComma takes always, complex-only, or never.
complex-only follows the AP complex-series rule.
numberStyle takes under-ten, under-hundred, or always-numerals.
Ages, dates, measurements, and percentages stay numerals at any threshold.
measurements takes abbreviate or spell-out.
measurements changes the notation only, never the unit system or the number.
percent and emDash values and what each changes.
enDashRanges is a boolean defaulting to false.
enDashRanges converts number-range hyphens; ellipsis picks the ellipsis form.
timeFormat takes three literal formats.
smartQuotes is a boolean defaulting to false.
smartQuotes applies the full apostrophe rule set.
brandCaps is a boolean defaulting to false.
brandCaps corrects only names on a curated list.
The settings screen edits the conventions once tidy is on.
A settings-screen save writes the conventions block into the same committed site config.
Section heading.
An editor adds a word to the personal dictionary from inside the tidy review.
The personal dictionary is a separate committed file, not a config choice.
Section heading.
Cairn checks the model output against the original and discards a failing result.
A failing result never reaches the review screen and the text stays unchanged.
The structural check backstops a bad rewrite and prompt injection, not the model second-guessing itself.
Conventions and the prompt govern voice; the structural check cannot.
Section heading.
A draft over about 24,000 characters is refused before the model is called.
The refusal tells the editor to select a shorter passage.
Key health results are cached for a ten-minute window.
Local development is claimed to inject a stubbed Anthropic client automatically.
Under the scaffold dev backend a canned client stands in for the Anthropic SDK.
Section heading.
Tidy does not replace spellcheck, which is configured separately.
Pointer to the editor guide.
Section heading.
The settings screen shows the editor tier of controls when tidy is set up.
Tidy on a draft yields a diff for review.
A refusal names its reason, such as tidy off, key missing, or body too long.
A rejected key returns a refusal naming the key problem.
Bare failures that state no reason merit a closer look.
